The Global Goth Edit: Six Icons for After-Dark Style 🖤

carousel // Nov 6, 2026

See it on TikTok

Halloween is officially over. Your dark era isn’t. 🖤

The Global Goth Edit brings six pop-culture muses into an after-dark fashion editorial. Black beauty, different silhouettes and distinct art treatments run through the collection. These are AI-created fan-fashion illustrations of fictional adults, rather than photographs or an official character collaboration.

Elvira: Goth Is Forever

A towering bouffant and a red lip anchor the look. Black fabric and a strong silhouette keep the drama in the styling.

Akasha: Vampire After Hours

Velvet and sculpted gold bring the vampire-queen inspiration into an evening look.

Morticia: Gothic All Season

A dramatic silhouette and emerald accents make the case for gothic style beyond Halloween.

Emily: Till Dark Do Us Part

Blue tulle and midnight romance draw from the bride in Corpse Bride.

Sally: Pumpkin Spice. Bite.

Patchwork and copper-toned makeup pick up Sally’s handmade character.

Adult Wednesday: Midnight Masquerade

Lace, dark braids and winged violet makeup shape this adult Wednesday reinterpretation.

Your turn

Which icon is your after-dark alter ego? Tell me your pick, 1–6, in the comments on the TikTok post.
